title: ANCFThinPlate
author: JG
description: compute optimal slopes scaling in ShellMesh functionality
releaseNotes: ShellMesh gives slopesScalingX/Y per element edge: the length for which the cubic edge passes through the mapped midpoint of the edge (on a circle the best cubic), on straight edges the derivative of the geometry times the parameter length; on a quarter cylinder the radius error falls from 5.8e-4 (chord lengths) to 3.5e-7; test model shellMeshSlopesScalingTest.py (revision2026c step RG4.20.5.1)
